name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hbound⟩ := boundedu
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, heq⟩ := Finite.exists_ne_map_eq_of_infinite
    (fun n (i : Fin 4) => (⟨_, hbound (n + i)⟩ : Icc B T))
  wlog h : a < b generalizing a b
  · exact this b a hab.symm heq.symm (by omega)
  have tail k : u (a + k) = u (b + k) := k.strongRecOn fun k ih => by
    by_cases hk : k < 4
    · simpa using congrFun heq ⟨k, hk⟩
    · apply @Int.cast_injective ℝ
      simp (disch := omega) only [(hu (a + k) (by omega)).1,
        (hu (b + k) (by omega)).1, Nat.add_sub_assoc, ih]
  refine ⟨a, b - a, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt h, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  convert (tail (n - a)).symm using 2 <;> omega

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  classical
  have hnum (d : Fin 9 → ℤ) : (∑ i : Fin 9, d i * 10 ^ i.val) = digits_to_num d :=
    (congrFun hdigits_to_num d).symm
  have upd (d e : Fin 9 → ℤ) (i : Fin 9) :
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then e j else d j) =
        (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.val + digits_to_num d := by
    rw [hdigits_to_num]
    calc
      _ = ∑ j : Fin 9, ((if j = i then (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.val else 0) + d j * 10 ^ j.val) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        by_cases hj : j = i
        · subst j
          simp only [ite_true, sub_mul, sub_add_cancel]
        · simp only [hj, if_false, zero_add]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq', if_pos (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  have hd (d e : Fin 9 → ℤ) (h : relation d e) (i : Fin 9) :
      7 ∣ (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.val + digits_to_num d := by
    rw [← upd]
    exact ((hrelation d e).mp h).2 i
  intro d e f ⟨hde, hef⟩ i
  have hsum : (7 : ℤ) ∣ ∑ j : Fin 9, ((e j - d j) * 10 ^ j.val + digits_to_num d) :=
    Finset.dvd_sum (fun j _ => hd d e hde j)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    hnum, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] at hsum
  have hs : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d := by
    convert dvd_sub hsum (dvd_mul_right (7 : ℤ) (digits_to_num d)) using 1 <;> ring
  have hw := dvd_sub (dvd_add (hd e f hef i) (hd d e hde i)) hs
  rw [add_add_add_comm, add_sub_cancel_right, ← add_mul, sub_add_sub_cancel] at hw
  have hc : IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 := ⟨3, -2, by decide⟩
  exact dvd_sub_comm.mp (hc.pow_right.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right hw)

name: putnam_1988_a2
proof:
theorem putnam_1988_a2
    (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : f = fun x ↦ Real.exp (x ^ 2)) :
    ((True) : Prop ) ↔
    (∃ a b : ℝ,
      a < b ∧
      ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ,
        (∃ x ∈ Ioo a b, g x ≠ 0) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℝ g (Ioo a b) ∧
        ∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, deriv (fun y ↦ f y * g y) x = (deriv f x) * (deriv g x)) := by
  subst f
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => Real.exp (x + Real.log (2 * x - 1) / 2)
  have hG (x : ℝ) (hx : 1 < x) : HasDerivAt g _ x :=
    ((hasDerivAt_id x).add
      (((((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul 2).sub_const 1).log
        (by linarith : 2 * x - 1 ≠ 0)).div_const 2)).exp
  rw [true_iff]
  refine ⟨1, 2, by norm_num, g, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨3 / 2, by norm_num, Real.exp_ne_zero _⟩
  · exact fun x hx => (hG x hx.1).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  · intro x hx
    have hF := (hasDerivAt_pow 2 x).exp
    change deriv ((fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (y ^ 2)) * g) x = _
    rw [(hF.mul (hG x hx.1)).deriv, hF.deriv, (hG x hx.1).deriv]
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, id_eq]
    linear_combination -Real.exp (x ^ 2) * g x *
      mul_inv_cancel₀ (show 2 * x - 1 ≠ 0 by linarith [hx.1])

name: putnam_2001_b1
proof:
theorem putnam_2001_b1
  (n : ℕ)
  (hn : n > 0) (hn' : Even n)
  (nums : Fin n → Fin n → ℤ)
  (colors : Fin n → Fin n → Fin 2)
  (hnums : ∀ k l, nums k l = k * n + l + 1)
  (hcolorsrows : ∀ k, (∑ l, (if (colors k l = 0) then 1 else 0)) = n / 2)
  (hcolorscols : ∀ l, (∑ k, (if (colors k l = 0) then 1 else 0)) = n / 2) :
  (∑ k, ∑ l, (if (colors k l = 0) then (nums k l) else 0)) = (∑ k, ∑ l, (if (colors k l = 1) then (nums k l) else 0)) := by
  let w := fun k l => (2 * ((if colors k l = 0 then 1 else 0 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1)
  have balance (f : Fin n → ℕ) (hf : (∑ i, f i) = n / 2) :
      (∑ i, (2 * (f i : ℤ) - 1)) = 0 := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Nat.cast_sum, hf,
      Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one,
      sub_eq_zero]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_div_cancel' hn'.two_dvd
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  calc
    _ = ∑ k, ∑ l, w k l * nums k l := by
      simp only [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
      dsimp only [w]
      generalize colors k l = c
      fin_cases c <;> simp
    _ = 0 := by
      simp only [hnums, add_assoc, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
        ← Finset.sum_mul, w, balance, hcolorsrows, zero_mul,
        Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      simp only [← Finset.sum_mul, balance, hcolorscols, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero]
